caption:
You don't need an HR team to track leave.

Every request gets noted in a register, then lost on salary day.
A small automation can read each request, log it in the register, update the leave balance and ping the manager to approve.

Example data.

DM AUDIT and I will look at your most repetitive process for free. Send this to whoever handles your leave register.

scenes.vo: Leave requests land on WhatsApp. They get noted in a register, then *lost* on salary day. Every month.
Here is the *fix.* Every request is logged the moment it arrives.
It *reads* the WhatsApp request, *logs* it in the register, and *updates* the leave balance.
Then it *pings* the manager to approve. The register stays correct on its own.
